name: ROSAP (US DOT National Transportation Library)
notes: ROSAP, the US DOT National Transportation Library repository, is live and describes itself as retaining 'documents in their original published format to ensure public access to scientific information'. No explicit copyright/licence statement appears on the fetched page, but as US DOT-authored materials the documents are US government works (public domain) per DOT policy. access=open, licence=public-domain and reuse_level=full-text-open are consistent. Evidence: https://rosap.ntl.bts.gov (read 2026-11-12)
